title: Medical foundation models converge less under label supervision
abstract: arXiv:2607.20274v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diagnostic classifiers and imaging biomarkers are fitted on the embeddings of medical foundation models. These models are replaced as new versions appear. This practice assumes that different models represent images alike. We tested this assumption with more than 750,000 images from 14 datasets in 5 imaging modalities, 18 public models, and 101 models trained on chest radiographs and histopathology that differ in pretraining objective, label type, size, random seed, initialization, training patients, or training recipe. Agreement was measured as the mutual k-nearest-neighbor overlap, the share of an image's nearest neighbors common to two models. Two public models shared on average 0.091 of the 10 nearest neighbors of a chest radiograph. A randomly initialized network shared 0.036 with them. In the four other modalities, they shared at most 0.300. On chest radiographs, agreement depended more on the source dataset and the radio

translated_title: 标签监督下医学基础模型的表征收敛程度更低
translated_abstract: 诊断分类器和影像生物标志物通常拟合在医学基础模型的嵌入表示之上，当新版本的模型出现时，这些基础模型就会被替换。这种做法隐含了一个假设：不同模型对图像的表征是相似的。我们用来自5种成像模态、14个数据集的超过75万张图像、18个公开模型，以及101个在胸片和组织病理学图像上训练的模型（这些模型在预训练目标、标签类型、模型规模、随机种子、初始化、训练患者或训练配方上各不相同）检验了这一假设。模型间的一致性用相互k近邻重叠度来衡量，即一张图像的最近邻中有多少是两个模型所共有的。两个公开模型在胸片图像的10个最近邻中平均仅有0.091的重叠，而随机初始化的网络与它们也有0.036的重叠。在其他四种成像模态中，重叠度至多为0.300。在胸片上，一致性更多取决于源数据集和……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对75万余张医学图像、18个公开模型和101个自训练模型的大规模分析发现，医学基础模型——尤其是经过标签监督训练的模型——对相同图像的表征彼此差异巨大，其近邻重叠度甚至接近随机初始化的水平，因此不同基础模型的嵌入不可互换使用。
en_tdlr: Through a large-scale analysis of over 750,000 medical images, 18 public models, and 101 self-trained models, this paper shows that medical foundation models—particularly those trained with label supervision—represent the same images very differently, with nearest-neighbor overlap barely above randomly initialized levels, meaning their embeddings are not interchangeable.
